title: Shinylive Minimal
text:
Adjust the parameters of the vertex form interactively:
Vertex Form: y = a(x - b)² + c
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 600

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from shiny import App, render, ui

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.h2("Parabola Explorer"),
    ui.layout_sidebar(
        ui.sidebar(
            ui.input_slider("a", "Stretch Factor (a):", -3, 3, 1, step=0.1),
            ui.input_slider("b", "X Shift (b):", -5, 5, 0, step=0.5),
            ui.input_slider("c", "Y Shift (c):", -10, 10, 0, step=0.5),
        ),
        ui.output_plot("parabola_plot", fill=True),
    ),
)

def server(input, output, session):
    @output
    @render.plot
    def parabola_plot():
        a = input.a()
        b = input.b()
        c = input.c()
        
        x = np.linspace(-10, 10, 200)
        y = a * (x - b)**2 + c
        
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
        ax.plot(x, y, linewidth=2.5, color="steelblue")
        ax.plot(b, c, "ro", markersize=10, label=f"Vertex ({b:.1f}, {c:.1f})")
        ax.axhline(y=0, color="black", linestyle="-", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.3)
        ax.axvline(x=0, color="black", linestyle="-", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.3)
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
        ax.set_xlabel("x", fontsize=12)
        ax.set_ylabel("y", fontsize=12)
        ax.set_title(f"y = {a:.2f}(x - {b:.2f})^2 + {c:.2f}", fontsize=14)
        ax.set_xlim(-10, 10)
        ax.set_ylim(-30, 40)
        ax.legend(fontsize=10)
        
        return fig

app = App(app_ui, server)
Try the sliders and observe how the parabola changes!
